title: FAIRFIL: CONTRASTIVE NEURAL DEBIASING METHOD FOR PRETRAINED TEXT ENCODERS
findings: The paper uses religion as a key example of a social bias that its proposed method, FairFil, is designed to mitigate. However, it does not provide any empirical results for religious bias, as all experiments were conducted on gender bias.

measurement_description: The paper proposes a method to measure and mitigate social bias in sentence embeddings, using major world religions as an example of a sensitive topic. However, the conducted experiments focused on gender bias, not religious bias.
